description: This Java class implements a no-operation metrics provider, implementing the Metrics interface with methods that perform no actions or return default values. It serves as a placeholder or stub for metrics collection within the Hono project.

classes.name: NoopBasedMetrics
classes.description: A no-op implementation of the Metrics interface, providing stub methods that do nothing or return default values.

methods.name: NoopBasedMetrics
methods.description: Constructor, protected to prevent external instantiation, indicating the class is intended to be instantiated optionally or via subclass.

methods.name: getNumberOfConnections
methods.description: Returns the number of active connections, always zero in this implementation.
